shared_elements: paired symmetrical motifs flanking a central axis
repeated small linear marks resembling a sign system
justification: Both surfaces are stone carved in shallow relief and both feature a prominent carved disc on a vertical central axis together with paired, symmetrically placed motifs and rows of small repeated sign-like marks. But A is a flat rectangular wall panel dominated by dense horizontal registers of fine linear text beneath a rayed disc and small standing figures, whereas B is a bulky three-dimensional monolith whose relief is subordinate to a sculpted head-and-torso silhouette, with bold, rounded, sparse motifs and no register system.
